regions.region: title, graphical abstract, abstract, and introduction
regions.finding: The graphical abstract is an overarching generic Au(I)-catalyzed transformation (18 examples, up to 93%) that summarizes the paper rather than an independent batch experiment; the prose contains background claims only.

unresolved: The generic R-group structures in the graphical abstract were not expanded into complete molecular structures or duplicated as a reaction record.

regions.region: upper-left Figure 1 and surrounding prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Figure 1 shows cited biologically active cyclopenta[b]indole compounds and the surrounding text reviews prior literature; these are not experiments reported in this paper.
A generic allene approach/retrosynthetic relationship is classified as a general scheme with no batch conditions or outcome.

The source summarizes multiple screenings of 1a with Au(PPh3)Cl/AgOTf in toluene at room temperature or reflux: the desired product was not observed and an unknown product formed. It is retained as an unresolved screening summary, not falsely split into fully specified rows.

unresolved: Scheme 2 does not expose the individual screening rows, catalyst loadings, times, exact temperatures, yields, or unknown-product identity.

regions.region: left-column Table 1 and adjacent optimization prose
regions.finding: All 15 optimization rows were extracted independently with catalyst/silver-salt presence or absence, temperature, solvent, time, product 2b NMR yield, and recovered 1b percentage. The 0.2 mmol scale, 5 mol% header loadings, toluene volume where explicit, and NMR/internal-standard basis were preserved.

Sixteen substrate-scope rows (1b-1q to 2b-2q) were extracted separately. Footnote b scale overrides, footnote c 10 mol% catalyst overrides, footnote d 115 °C override, hours/days, and product-specific reported yields were applied only to their marked rows.

The 1r-to-2r and 1s-to-2s electron-withdrawing-group examples and the distinct gram-scale 1o-to-2o batch were extracted as three experiments; the gram-scale row was not merged with the different Table 2 1o-to-2o experiment.

unresolved: Table 2 and Scheme 3 do not state yield measurement basis, workup, or purification in the main text.
The footnote's 2 mL wording explicitly names toluene, so solvent volume was not assigned to Table 1 non-toluene rows.
Depicted substrate and product structures remain unverified and most are label-only rather than source-verified SMILES.

regions.finding: Two independent synthetic applications were extracted: Suzuki coupling 2h-to-3h (90%) and the 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition 2o-to-3o (97%), including every depicted reagent loading/equivalent and the reported time, solvent, and temperature/reflux condition.

The toluene/D4-acetic-acid and D8-toluene labeling experiments were kept separate with 82%/84% D and 89%/86% D outcomes respectively. The second row does not independently restate D4-acetic acid, so that participant was not inferred.

regions.region: right-column Scheme 5 catalytic cycle and adjacent mechanistic prose
regions.finding: The gold-mediated cycle through proposed intermediates A/A', B, and C is classified as a mechanism rather than an additional experiment.

regions.region: lower columns conclusion, acknowledgments, and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: No additional batch experiment is reported. The notice says SI exists online, but no SI file was explicitly supplied or associated in this workspace, so no SI details were imported.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits reaction scale, solvent volume, yield basis, workup, and purification.
It is ambiguous whether Scheme 5's 10 equiv D4-acetic-acid line applies to the D8-toluene row; the ambiguity is preserved instead of guessed.
SI availability in the article does not establish an associated local SI document.
